top_signals.title: Investors Need to Assume $100 Oil Until Yearend, Principal's Shah
top_signals.summary: Seema Shah, chief global strategist at Principal Asset Management, discusses the impact of higher oil prices on inflation, Federal Reserve monetary policy and investment portfolios. "Assuming that oil prices remain at around $100 a barrel until the end of the year has to be part of the decision-making process when we're thinking about portfolios," Shah tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: An Inversion of the US Yield Curve Becomes New Risk as Fed Hikes
top_signals.summary: The bond market is on the brink of signaling that a series of Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes will start shifting the narrative toward the risk that the US economy stalls out.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
